description.p: A powerful artifact. Grants Drakvision 120ft, increases Armor Class by 1, and once per long rest you can turn ethereal for 1 minute.
While holding this shield, you gain a +1 bonus to wisdom.

Oak Father's Wrath (3/long rest): Once per turn, as an action or bonus action, you call upon the ancient will of the wild. Grasping vines and roots erupt from the ground beneath a creature within 20 feet. The Target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be restrained until the end of its next turn.

Matron's Retribution (3/long rest): When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to unleash forceful unseen energy. The attacker takes 3d6 force damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away. On a success, it takes half damage and isn't pushed.
